dimm_configuration: RECORD capacity, channels, ranks, speed, timing policy
other_host_activity: RECORD observed workload and quiet-host condition
smt_sibling_condition: RECORD sibling CPU and observed activity
host_lease: RECORD operator-authorized reservation identity; not harness self-attestation
thermal_condition: RECORD starting temperature and ambient/cooling conditions
power_policy_notes: RECORD existing governor, boost/PBO and power limits; do not change silently
cpu_microcode_firmware: RECORD firmware and microcode if not available through sysfs
frequency_observation: RECORD sustained vs burst behavior separately, or unavailable
